front: What is INP (Interaction to Next Paint) in one sentence?
back: Core Web Vital measuring responsiveness — latency from user input to next frame paint — replaces FID (2024).

front: Explain the mental model of INP (Interaction to Next Paint) (how the system thinks).
back: INP captures worst-case (or high percentile) delay between interaction (click, tap, key) and when the browser paints the next frame showing feedback. Target: ≤ 200 ms good, 200–500 ms needs improvement, > 500 ms poor.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for INP (Interaction to Next Paint)?
back: User click → Main thread busy? ──yes──► delay (long task)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for INP (Interaction to Next Paint)?
back: 1. Performance panel → record → interact → find Long tasks (> 50 ms). 2. Performance insights → INP breakdown (input delay, processing, presentation delay).

front: Symptom: INP poor, LCP good — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Long tasks on interaction · Fix: Profile click handler; split work

front: Symptom: Spikes only mobile — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Slower CPU, 4x throttling · Fix: Reduce JS; simplify DOM

front: Symptom: After deploy regression — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: New sync JSON parse · Fix: Stream/chunk; Web Worker

front: Symptom: Third-party widgets — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Tag managers on click · Fix: Delay load; facade buttons

front: Symptom: INP N/A in report — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: No interactions / bfcache · Fix: Normal for static pages

front: Gotcha with INP (Interaction to Next Paint): what silently fails?
back: Optimizing LCP alone won't fix INP — hero image fast but 800 ms click handler still fails CWV.

front: When should you NOT use INP (Interaction to Next Paint)?
back: Don't chase sub-50 ms INP on internal admin tools with 5 users — focus on critical revenue paths first.

front: What is Layout (reflow) in one sentence?
back: Browser calculates geometry — sizes and positions of elements — render pipeline stage between style and paint.

front: Explain the mental model of Layout (reflow) (how the system thinks).
back: Layout (reflow) computes where boxes go. One element's size can ripple up and down the tree — layout is often global within a subtree.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Layout (reflow)?
back: Style recalc → Layout → Paint → Composite → triggered by geometry-changing properties

front: Given a broken Layout (reflow) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Style recalc → Layout → Paint → Composite

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Layout (reflow)?
back: Performance → Layout events in flame chart Rendering tab → Layout Shift Regions (CLS related)

front: Symptom: Jank on scroll — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Sticky + height reads · Fix: passive: true listeners; avoid layout in scroll

front: Symptom: ResizeObserver loop error — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Feedback resize · Fix: Debounce; don't set size from observer blindly

front: Symptom: Slow list filter — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Re-layout 10k nodes · Fix: Virtual list; key stability

front: Symptom: CLS on font swap — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Layout shift metric · Fix: size-adjust, reserve space

front: Symptom: Animation stutters — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Animating top/left · Fix: Switch to transform

front: Gotcha with Layout (reflow): what silently fails?
back: getBoundingClientRect() in hot path forces layout if DOM dirty — cache per frame.

front: When should you NOT use Layout (reflow)?
back: Don't contain: strict on everything — breaks positioning (position: fixed descendants).

front: What is Paint (repaint) in one sentence?
back: Fill pixels after layout — text, colors, borders, shadows — often split into layers for compositing.

front: Explain the mental model of Paint (repaint) (how the system thinks).
back: After Rendering performance/layout, paint records draw lists per layer (what to draw where). GPU composite merges layers. Changing paint-only properties skips layout but still repaints.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Paint (repaint)?
back: Layout complete → Paint records (fill, stroke, text, images) → Layers → Composite (GPU)

front: Given a broken Paint (repaint) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Layout complete

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Paint (repaint)?
back: 1. Rendering → Paint flashing (green flashes = repaints) 2. Layers panel — see promoted layers, memory cost 3. Performance trace — Paint and Raster slices

front: Symptom: Full-screen green flash — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Whole page repaints · Fix: Reduce layer count; fix hover rules on *

front: Symptom: Memory climb — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Too many layers · Fix: Remove excessive will-change

front: Symptom: Text blurry after animate — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Subpixel transform · Fix: Snap to integer px

front: Symptom: Scroll jank with fixed bg — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: background-attachment: fixed · Fix: Use pseudo-element layer

front: Symptom: Canvas + DOM overlap — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Duplicate paint · Fix: Single surface or isolate iframe

front: Gotcha with Paint (repaint): what silently fails?
back: will-change on everything — each layer consumes GPU memory; mobile OOM and worse perf.

front: When should you NOT use Paint (repaint)?
back: Don't micro-optimize paint on static marketing pages with no interaction — Rendering performance/INP and LCP dominate.

front: What is Refresh rate in one sentence?
back: Display hardware cadence — frames must be ready before vsync or user sees jank — 60 Hz ≈ 16.67 ms budget.

front: Explain the mental model of Refresh rate (how the system thinks).
back: Screen refreshes at fixed Hz (60, 90, 120, 144). Browser must produce a frame before each vsync or frame drops (stutter).

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Refresh rate?
back: Browser target: complete JS + layout + paint within ~10 ms (60 Hz) → leaves headroom for compositor + system

front: Given a broken Refresh rate setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Browser target: complete JS + layout + paint within ~10 ms (60 Hz)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Refresh rate?
back: Enable 120 Hz on device/emulator Chrome DevTools → Rendering → FPS meter Throttle CPU 4× to simulate mobile

front: Symptom: Visible stutter in animation — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Long tasks > frame period · Fix: Split work; compositor-only props

front: Symptom: 30 FPS on 120 Hz panel — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Every other frame missed · Fix: Profile; reduce paint cost

front: Symptom: rAF runs but nothing moves — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Logic bug vs display · Fix: Verify transform updates

front: Symptom: Background tab slow — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Browser throttles rAF · Fix: Expected — pause work on visibilitychange

front: Symptom: VSync tear (games/native) — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Full-screen exclusive · Fix: Web uses compositor — different stack

front: Gotcha with Refresh rate: what silently fails?
back: Meeting 10 ms on desktop ≠ mobile — same site at 4× CPU throttle may miss 16 ms budget.

front: When should you NOT use Refresh rate?
back: Non-visual batch jobs — don't tie to rAF; use setTimeout or Worker.
